description: The World Cities Lexicon provides a structured list of major cities across world regions. Technical University of Darmstadt researchers combine administrative classifications, population figures, geographic identifiers and official digital addresses to clarify which units are being compared. Zenodo supplies the dataset as an Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. The deposit supports the accompanying data note on defining urban administrative units. Population reference years and administrative definitions vary across countries, so the table should not be treated as a single harmonised census year or a building-footprint product. It can help define simulation study areas, match city names and attach population-based demand weights. It complements data-copernicus-ghsl-built-up-population, which represents settlement and population spatially using a different definition of urban extent.
